title: Head & Shoulders Launches All-New Scalp Care Collection to Prove Healthier Hair Starts at the Scalp
summary: Head & Shoulders Launches All-New Scalp Care Collection to Prove Healthier Hair Starts at the Scalp
body_markdown:
*A skincare-powered innovation for clinically proven scalp care from the #1 US Dermatologist recommended anti-dandruff brand*


CINCINNATI--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Head & Shoulders today unveiled its new[Scalp Care Collection](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fheadandshoulders.com%2Fen-us%2Fcollections%2Fscalp-care-collection&esheet=54622382&newsitemid=20261015305640&lan=en-US&anchor=Scalp+Care+Collection&index=1&md5=462abe4380ea5242d5abcabd2a7174ec) , a line of skincare-inspired shampoos, conditioners and treatments built to care for the scalp while delivering the hair benefits people desire most. The collection features three personalized regimens designed for specific scalp needs that are clinically proven to remove visible flakes at the source and repair the scalp barrier for healthier-looking hair, bringing a new level of beauty to a brand best known for scalp care.


“This launch marks a bold new chapter for the brand, one that removes dandruff and moves beyond just managing flakes to transforming how hair looks and feels by taking a skincare-inspired approach to common scalp concerns,” said Matt Krehbiel, Vice President, Head & Shoulders. “We're showing people that exceptional hair starts at the scalp through educational content and partnerships with trusted experts and relatable voices in beauty.”


The collection targets the root causes of scalp damage in three ways: gently removing flakes, fighting oxidative scalp stress and restoring the scalp barrier. The formulas feature the brand's HydraSC+ Complex, built on either 1.8% salicylic acid, which exfoliates and lifts away flakes and buildup, or 1% zinc pyrithione, which targets Malassezia, the scalp microbe associated with dandruff. Consumers can select the regimen best suited to their scalp concerns:


- **Scalp Soothe with Niacinamide (for itchy* scalps):** Instant cooling and dandruff itch relief from the first use, with shampoo delivering an added boost of hair shine. The regimen includes the[Cooling Shampoo](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fheadandshoulders.com%2Fen-us%2Fproducts%2Fhead-shoulders-scalp-soothe-anti-dandruff-cooling-shampoo&esheet=54622382&newsitemid=20261015305640&lan=en-US&anchor=Cooling+Shampoo&index=2&md5=44338b9f74044b0d9776fd84d02814ae) and[Cooling Scalp Spray](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fheadandshoulders.com%2Fen-us%2Fproducts%2Fhead-shoulders-scalp-soothe-anti-dandruff-cooling-spray-with-niacinamide&esheet=54622382&newsitemid=20261015305640&lan=en-US&anchor=Cooling+Scalp+Spray&index=3&md5=28c64002bbdba7c082112b57a378c4a9) , which can be used up to 4 times daily for relief between washes.


- **Scalp Purify with Salicylic Acid (for oily scalps):** Instantly removes up to 99% of flakes, oil and buildup for up to 5x more volume in one color-safe, non-stripping routine. The regimen includes the[Clarifying Pre-Shampoo](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fheadandshoulders.com%2Fen-us%2Fproducts%2Fhead-shoulders-scalp-purify-anti-dandruff-clarify-pre-shampoo-salicylic-acid&esheet=54622382&newsitemid=20261015305640&lan=en-US&anchor=Clarifying+Pre-Shampoo&index=4&md5=980aabc5823a0e0a9d7d4c948d2dd8c5) and[Volumizing Shampoo](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fheadandshoulders.com%2Fen-us%2Fproducts%2Fhead-shoulders-scalp-purify-anti-dandruff-volumizing-shampoo&esheet=54622382&newsitemid=20261015305640&lan=en-US&anchor=Volumizing+Shampoo&index=5&md5=6dd94c05bb6b14b7559e2229ff0f5567) .


- **Scalp Restore with Bio-Ceramides (for dry scalps):** Delivers 72-moisture lock and restores the scalp barrier for hydrated hair. The sulfate-free regimen includes the[Nourishing Shampoo](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fheadandshoulders.com%2Fen-us%2Fproducts%2Fhead-shoulders-scalp-restore-anti-dandruff-nourishing-shampoo&esheet=54622382&newsitemid=20261015305640&lan=en-US&anchor=Nourishing+Shampoo&index=6&md5=f5c1516636def40287004c373dc3acc6) ,[Nourishing Conditioner](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fheadandshoulders.com%2Fen-us%2Fproducts%2Fhead-shoulders-scalp-restore-anti-dandruff-conditioner-deep-hydration&esheet=54622382&newsitemid=20261015305640&lan=en-US&anchor=Nourishing+Conditioner&index=7&md5=28e4e3748911d754a93b94044191ff52) and[Nourishing Leave-On Serum](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fheadandshoulders.com%2Fen-us%2Fproducts%2Fhead-shoulders-scalp-restore-anti-dandruff-leave-on-serum-boosts-scalp-moisture&esheet=54622382&newsitemid=20261015305640&lan=en-US&anchor=Nourishing+Leave-On+Serum&index=8&md5=7d824fd07df20870fbe91798e3a3717a) .


Shampoos and conditioners within the Head & Shoulders Scalp Care Collection are now available at Walmart with a suggested MSRP of $11.99. Treatments and expanded availability at Walmart and other retailers arrive this November. For more information, visit[headandshoulders.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fheadandshoulders.com%2Fen-us&esheet=54622382&newsitemid=20261015305640&lan=en-US&anchor=headandshoulders.com&index=9&md5=a308dfea23b9dceb5c2b8cf583343e4a) or follow Head & Shoulders on[Instagram](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Fheadandshoulders%2F&esheet=54622382&newsitemid=20261015305640&lan=en-US&anchor=Instagram&index=10&md5=6cbe093ea04d89cdf5211d0cc681979a) ,[TikTok](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tiktok.com%2F%40headandshoulders&esheet=54622382&newsitemid=20261015305640&lan=en-US&anchor=TikTok&index=11&md5=e7a10a17ca3024afede143b9101b782a) and[Facebook](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2Fheadandshouldersusa&esheet=54622382&newsitemid=20261015305640&lan=en-US&anchor=Facebook&index=12&md5=154af1cc012c2dc49b5e5a8ad41c0c72) .
